whatThisPilotStoresWhyItStoresItAnd: What this pilot stores, why it stores it, and what you can remove. Updated 15 October 2026.
privateRecordsInAPublicSourceProject: Private records in a public-source project
teddMhenIsOperatedByTheOwnerOfThis: Tedd’mhen is operated by the owner of this deployment on their Cloudflare account. The source code is public; your journal entries are not. Each account can access only its own records. The operator and authorized Cloudflare administrators can administer the database; this is not end-to-end encrypted storage.
savingACheckInSendsYourSelectedRatingsTr: Saving a check-in sends your selected ratings, training, sleep, physiology, symptoms, context labels, optional notes, date, time zone, and revision metadata to Cloudflare D1. Account records contain your email identifier, a salted password hash, a hash of your recovery code, and session records. Passwords and recovery codes are not stored as readable text.
emailAddressesAreNotVerifiedInThisPilotN: Email addresses are not verified in this pilot. No verification or reset emails are sent. Use a unique password and save your recovery code; possession of the code and email enables a password reset.
relationshipCalculationsAndBayesianModel: Relationship calculations and Bayesian models run in your browser using your selected observations. Written notes are not used as model inputs. Downloaded model reports can contain selected measurements and labels, so treat them as personal data.
importFilesAreReadAndValidatedInYourBrow: Import files are read and validated in your browser. Confirmation saves the reviewed observations to your signed-in account. Imported data follows the same storage and deletion rules as manual check-ins. Source account IDs and revisions are not imported.
theApplicationSAdministratorPanelExposes: The application’s administrator panel exposes aggregate account counts, journal JSON volume and recent activity. It does not display individual email addresses or journal contents. Infrastructure administrators still have database access as described above.
necessarySignInCookieHttponlySecureAndSa: Necessary sign-in cookie. HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax in production. Journal contents are not stored in it.
upTo7DaysRevokedBySignOutRecovery: Up to 7 days; revoked by sign-out, recovery, password change or account deletion.
cloudflareMaySetSecurityCookiesTheLegacy: Cloudflare may set security cookies. The legacy owner migration route also uses Access cookies, including <slot0>CF_Authorization</slot0>; ordinary account sign-in does not use Access.
cloudflareConfigurationAndSessionSetting: Cloudflare configuration and session settings determine expiry; the migration Access session is configured for 24 hours.
localStorageForAutoLightDarkAndOptionalA: Local storage for Auto / Light / Dark and optional approximate coordinates.
untilChangedForgottenOrBrowserSiteDataIs: Until changed, forgotten, or browser site data is cleared.
localStorageRememberingThatThisNoticeWas: Local storage remembering that this notice was dismissed. Dismissal does not enable tracking or grant location permission.
untilSiteDataIsClearedOrTheNoticeVersion: Until site data is cleared or the notice version changes.
noAdvertisingCookiesAnalyticsSdksThirdPa: No advertising cookies, analytics SDKs, third-party fonts, or tracking pixels are added by this application. Blocking necessary cookies prevents sign-in. Clearing local preferences does not delete database records. The browser may separately cache public application files.
seeCloudflareSCookieDocumentationAndAcce: See Cloudflare’s <slot0> cookie documentation </slot0> and <slot1> Access cookie documentation </slot1> for infrastructure cookies.
optionalLocationForAutomaticAppearance: Optional location for language and appearance
appearanceUseDeviceLocationRequestsBrows: Appearance or Language → Use device location requests browser permission after your click. Coordinates are rounded to two decimal places and saved only in this browser, separately from your journal. Sunrise, sunset and a country-based language suggestion are calculated on your device using a bundled map. This application does not send those coordinates to its API, database, or an external sun-time service.
yourBrowserOrOperatingSystemMayUseItsOwn: Your browser or operating system may use its own location provider to determine your position. There is no background location tracking. Update the saved location when travelling, or choose Forget saved location. Without a location, Auto uses English and a light theme. Manual language and theme choices override automatic settings.
journalEntriesRemainInTheActiveDatabaseU: Journal entries remain in the active database until you delete them. Delete individual days from Daily check-in, or delete your account and all entries from Account. Password changes and recovery invalidate previous sessions immediately; expired session rows are cleaned up when new sessions are created.
deletedDataMayRemainInCloudflareRecovery: Deleted data may remain in Cloudflare recovery history for the applicable retention window. D1 Time Travel currently retains up to 7 days on Workers Free or 30 days on Workers Paid. Manual migration backups are retained for at most 30 days unless an incident requires a documented exception. An infrastructure restore can bring back older records; the operator must review deletions before restoring service. See <slot0> Cloudflare’s recovery documentation </slot0> .
exportsAreDownloadedToADestinationYouCho: Exports are downloaded to a destination you choose. Deleting data here does not remove downloaded files or copies shared elsewhere. No LLM is connected to Tedd’mhen; uploading an export to another service is your separate action. Shared synthetic demo records are stored in D1 under a technical owner without sign-in credentials. Anyone can explore them at /demo without an account. Your demo edits and imports stay only in this tab’s memory and disappear when you leave demo mode or reload; they never update your personal journal or the shared examples.
cloudflareProcessesRequestsToServeTheApp: Cloudflare processes requests to serve the application and may process IP addresses, security events and operational metadata under its policies. Authentication rate limits use short-lived hashed IP/email keys. Application error logs exclude credentials, recovery codes, and journal bodies. The database was provisioned in Cloudflare’s EEUR region; this is not a promise that all infrastructure processing stays in that region.
thePilotHasNoSubscriptionChargeOrApplica: The pilot has no subscription charge or application-imposed user-count cap. Storage, traffic and compute remain subject to Cloudflare quotas. For a data issue, contact the deployment operator privately; never put health records, passwords or exports into the public repository.
languageStorage: Local storage for your manual or automatic language preference. Journal data and notes are not translated.
